description: Search the Handshakr suppliers an AI agent may read, by keyword and optional category. Returns name, slug, category, location, description and `contactable`: true only for suppliers who have switched agent access on, the only ones an agent may approach. Claimed suppliers who have not consented are not returned. `description` and `category` are the company's own words or null; text Handshakr wrote from public sources is in `handshakr_summary` / `handshakr_category`, labelled, and is not a fact about the company. `trust_score` is null: no score is computed.

limit.description: Maximum number of suppliers to return (1 to 50, default 10).

query.description: Search term matched against seller name and description.

name: search_sellers
title: Search sellers
